value.rationale: A complete tight-frame existence and phase-alphabet design classification at redundancy 3/2 for three arithmetic-progression shifts and half-order modulations. It reveals an exact parity/three-torsion obstruction, proves the minimum quantization of three phases, counts every indexed design and supplies exact noise-stability spectra. These answers address a natural structured sensor/frame design problem rather than arbitrary numerical instances.
